# Redis Standards

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Enterprise Standards](../../README.md) • [Technology Standards](../README.md)**

---

> This directory contains Redis specific standards for enterprise environments. These standards provide comprehensive guidance for Redis cache configuration, data modeling, caching strategies, queueing patterns, security implementation, performance optimization, and high availability patterns to ensure consistent and scalable Redis deployments.

These standards ensure consistent, secure, and scalable Redis implementations across the platform. They complement the general infrastructure standards with Redis-specific guidance for:

- Cluster configuration and node management
- Key naming conventions and data modeling patterns
- Caching strategies and TTL management
- Message queueing with Redis Streams
- Security policies and access control
- Performance optimization and monitoring
- High availability and disaster recovery
